text: Average order value went up by 10000 BRL between 2017-05 and 2017-06. The largest contribution came from MG (6000 BRL). The second largest contribution came from BA (4000 BRL). Average order value is defined as: Revenue divided by delivered orders The figure comes from raw.orders, raw.order_payments; the logged cleaning steps are parse_dates, drop_exact_duplicates.
